verdict.rationale: A government immigration agency could plausibly publish bulk datasets or statistics extracts, so this axis applies. The only evidence is a probe where TLS verification failed and nothing on the host was fetched, so nothing shows AIMA publishing downloadable datasets, registry extracts or case statistics. Confidence is low because the site could not be inspected.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping
